prompt: A cramped shared kitchen with a lino floor, a pale laminate worktop, a chipped sink full of mugs and a grease-spotted cooker, filmed from a fixed point high on top of a wall cupboard. Brandon stands in the middle of the frame, small from above, holding a slab of dark raw liver in both hands near his mouth, with a yellow reduced sticker on its plastic tray at his elbow. His brows are pinched together, his nose is wrinkled, his eyes are watering and his lips are curled back from his teeth. A single flickering fluorescent tube overhead is the only light, giving everything a cold green-white cast. Washed-out, slightly compressed colour with faint grain. Thanks.
